# CaseGuard

> CaseGuard is an AI-powered redaction platform that automates the removal of sensitive data (PII, PHI, PCI) from videos, audio, documents, and images for compliance with FOIA, HIPAA, FERPA, and GDPR regulations.

CaseGuard serves law enforcement, healthcare, education, government, legal, financial services, and other regulated industries with bulk redaction capabilities that process files 10-95x faster than manual methods. The platform specializes in clearing backlogs of sensitive materials while maintaining strict compliance with privacy regulations.

## Core Redaction Software

- [AI Video Redaction Software](https://caseguard.com/video-redaction-software): AI-powered video redaction software blurring faces, plates & screens 32x faster
- [AI Document Redaction Software](https://caseguard.com/document-redaction-software): Automated document redaction for PII, PHI, PCI from PDFs & emails 10x faster
- [AI Audio Redaction Software](https://caseguard.com/audio-redaction-software): AI audio redaction via transcripts removing PII & PCI 95% faster for compliance
- [AI Image Redaction Software](https://caseguard.com/image-redaction-software): AI image redaction auto-detecting faces, plates, screens from thousands instantly
- [AI Bulk Redaction Software](https://caseguard.com/bulk-redaction-software): AI bulk redaction for unlimited videos, audio, documents clearing backlogs 85%
- [AI Transcription and Translation Software](https://caseguard.com/transcription-translation-software): AI transcription & translation processing audio files in minutes with 100+ languages
